title: DripDropz Open Source Voting Petition Management

ms.promise:
・Milestone 1: UX/UI Implementation (1 Month)
・Research Existing Solutions
・Build User Journey/User Experience
・Implement UI in Figma
ms.criteria: UX/UI Implementation will have a deliverable of a UI created in a Figma document and shared publicly with the community.
ms.report:
The goals for Milestone 1 were as follows:
・Milestone 1: UX/UI Implementation (1 Month) - The activities listed here took place in the last thirty days.
・Research Existing Solutions - We evaluated petition management from corporate governance and change.org.
・Build User Journey/User Experience - We walked through our existing user journey, and identified the appropriate locations to implement the petition management system both in the administrative areas, as well as the front end.
・Implement UI in Figma - The UI is implemented in Figma according to the needs of our lead developer.

There was concern from one of the reviewers in the previous round of approvals that they did not see the user journey, and did not understand the changes in the UI. Our designers are suggesting a new UI improvement to our tooling. We added the user journey to the Figma, and we brought back both the old UI and the new UI so that reviewers can see both.
Our deliverable is a publicly available Figma document. That document is located here: https://www.figma.com/file/ZQLJo5IZIa0B8NcZ0kGecX/DripDropz-Open-Source-Voting-Petition-Management?type=design&node-id=0%3A1&mode=design&t=tLx0UV7M4dDDBd2F-1
